title: Future Completion with Conjunctions of Time

sections.content:
You know *cuando* and *en cuanto* + present subjunctive for future events from A2 Unit 27 (*Te llamo cuando termine*). When the first action must be finished before the second one, use *haya* + participle:

• **cuando**: *Te llamo cuando haya terminado de cocinar.* (I'll call you when I have finished cooking.)
• **en cuanto / tan pronto como**: *En cuanto hayamos llegado a casa, te mandaré un mensaje.* (As soon as we have got home, I'll send you a message.)
• **with a command**: *Llámame cuando hayas terminado.* (Call me when you have finished.)

sections.title: Rules and Patterns
rows: Cuando hayas leído el libro, hablamos.
En cuanto haya salido el sol, saldremos.
Tan pronto como hayamos comido, nos vamos.

items.spanish: Te responderé en cuanto haya revisado todos los documentos.
items.english: I will answer you as soon as I have reviewed all the documents.

items.spanish: Podrás salir cuando hayas ordenado tu habitación.
items.english: You will be able to go out when you have tidied your room.

items.spanish: Celebraremos tan pronto como hayamos firmado el acuerdo.
items.english: We will celebrate as soon as we have signed the agreement.

sections.content: The clause with *haya* + participle names the action that is finished first; the main verb says what happens after it.
